name: Pizzeria Buongiorno
kurzbeschreibung: **Pizzeria Buongiorno in Tirol** Welcome to **Pizzeria Buongiorno** in the heart of **Tirol**! Here, authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the Alps. Enjoy freshly baked **pizza**, handmade pasta, and delicious **Kaiserschmarrn** in a cozy atmosphere. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita** or a hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, our menu has something for everyone. Pair your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a crisp local beer. Located near **Innsbruck**, we’re the perfect stop for travelers exploring **Tirol**’s stunning landscapes and rich culture. Come taste the sun of Italy in the mountains of **Tirol**! Opening Hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM Sat–Sun: 12:00 PM – 11:00 PM Contact: 📞 +43 123 456789 ✉️ info@buongiorno-tirol.at 📍 Hauptstraße 12, 6020 **Innsbruck**
